subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Trial milestone sync & next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acmepbc.com>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmepbc.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Trial milestone sync & next steps

Hi Emily / Jordan —

Quick MAP checkpoint for the week. Below is where we stand on the POC milestones and the owners we assigned. Please flag anything that seems off and add any missing acceptance criteria from your side.

Milestones (target dates):
- Environment & data access confirmed — owner: Aditya (target: 3/5)
- Baseline inference run (redwood-hosted) on sample dataset — owner: Marissa (target: 3/7)
- Latency and throughput testing (95th / steady-state) — owner: Connor (target: 3/9)
- Quality eval & acceptance review (customer rubric) — owner: Mina (target: 3/10)
- Final go/no-go readiness review — owner: Lauren (target: 3/12)

Acceptance criteria (proposal):
- Functional: end-to-end inference on the provided dataset with no data leaks and model outputs matching expected tokenization/format.
- Performance: 95th percentile latency <= 700ms for average request size (<= 512 tokens) under POC traffic profile.
- Reliability: <1% error rate (server errors/timeouts) over a 1-hour soak.
- Quality: Customer-rated pass on 200 sample prompts by your rubric, with >=4/5 mean score or no more than 8 regressions vs baseline.

Blockers we know about:
- We still need the S3 credentials for the dataset (Emily).
- Your security team asked for a short network diagram and list of outbound IPs (Jordan).

Attachments: MAP_v1.3.xlsx (runsheet + action items), poc_eval_checklist.md (rubric + sample prompts).

Proposed cadence: weekly sync (Tue 10am PT) + async updates in the MAP spreadsheet.

Thanks — I put next steps inline below.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v1.3.xlsx]
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acmepbc.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@acmepbc.com>, Acme PBC - Sales Ops <acme-salesops@acmepbc.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Trial milestone sync & next steps

Lauren —

Thanks for the clear list. Quick updates from our side:
- S3 credentials: we're packaging a read-only role; Ops expects to send role ARN by EOD 3/4.
- Network diagram / outbound IPs: Jordan is pulling those together — should be in your inbox 3/5.
- Acceptance criteria: the quality rubric looks good; one ask — can the latency target be a rolling 95th <= 800ms instead of 700ms? Our internal infra has heavier payloads. If you can run both targets (700/800) that would help.

Blocker: our security team flagged that they need an exported list of redwood console audit events for the trial week. Is that something you can provide or mock for the POC?

We'll confirm details after Jordan sends the network info.

—Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Product, Acme PBC
[Attachment: acme_network_requirements.pdf]
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acmepbc.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Trial milestone sync & next steps

Emily / team —

Appreciate the quick turn on the S3 role ARN. Once we have the ARN I will:
- Confirm access and run a small sanity download (owner: Aditya, due: 3/6 EOD).
- Share temporary evaluation credentials for the POC and a short README for the dataset path.

On the audit events ask: we can provide a sampled export of console events for the trial window (auth/requests/errors). We'll produce a one-page CSV with timestamps and event categories; Marissa will own that export. If your security team needs an HSM/KMS attestation, we can loop in security — let us know the exact format.

Also noting the latency target — we can run both 700ms and 800ms envelopes and report both. For the POC report we'll flag where we meet 700ms and where we only meet 800ms.

Action items assigned:
- Aditya: confirm dataset access + credentials (3/6)
- Marissa: produce console-sampled audit export (3/7)
- Connor: prepare steady-state latency runbook (3/8)
- Mina: finalize eval rubrics and sample set (3/9)

I'll update the MAP spreadsheet once access is confirmed.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: none]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acmepbc.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Trial milestone sync & next steps

Team / Emily —

Baseline run completed on 3/7 against the sample dataset (1000 prompts). Summary:
- Functional: end-to-end runs succeeded for 1000/1000 prompts; no tokenization mismatches.
- Latency: median ~120ms, 95th ~650ms for 256-token average requests. Under heavier payloads (512 tokens) 95th rose to ~780ms.
- Errors: <0.6% server errors, mostly timeouts on a minority of long-running requests.
- Quality: initial blind eval (50 random prompts, customer rubric) mean score 4.15/5; 6 regressions vs Acme baseline.

Notes / blockers:
- We still need the final S3 role ARN to run the full 10k sample (blocked since 3/4).
- A small dataset cleanup is recommended (dedupe + remove partial docs). Connor and I will provide a quick script.

Proposed acceptance pass thresholds updated to reflect observed numbers:
- Performance pass: 95th <= 800ms for stated payload mix; preferred target 700ms.
- Quality pass: mean score >= 4.0/5 with <=10 regressions.

I'll attach the raw run logs and a short summary CSV.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: baseline_run_20260307_summary.csv]
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@acmepbc.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP checkpoint: Trial milestone sync & next steps

Thanks, all — good progress and clear asks. Quick summary & next steps before our 3/12 readiness review: 

Open items (owners / due):
- Acme to provide S3 role ARN and confirm access method (Emily, due 3/10 EOD) — blocker for full run.
- Redwood to produce sampled console audit export (Marissa, due 3/11).
- Connor to run steady-state latency soak for 1 hour at POC traffic profile and report 95th (Connor, due 3/11).
- Mina to complete the 200-sample customer rubric evaluation and share pass/fail list (Mina, due 3/10 EOD).
- Aditya to share temporary eval creds and dataset path in the MAP file (Aditya, due 3/10 noon).

If we have all of the above by EOD 3/11 we will proceed to the readiness review on 3/12 and aim to provide a pass/fail recommendation mid-day. If the S3 access doesn't arrive, we will run the reduced sample and clearly annotate the coverage gap.

Next sync: 3/12 10am PT — 30 min readiness review. Please update the MAP_v1.3 spreadsheet with status changes as soon as you complete items.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_v1.3.xlsx]
